purpose: 24 source-RAW form talent ownership riders, 14 technique-to-power links, two temporary Power secrets, and twelve scoped regimen outcome modifiers.

eventSemantics.FormRider: Matching Lightsaber Form talent OWNERSHIP grants the printed rider; an activated lightsaber gates base Form Power use. No active-form stance check applies to Form Power riders.
eventSemantics.ForceTechnique: Related Power use modification; separate acquisition prerequisite check.
eventSemantics.ForceSecret: FP grants temporary nonrecoverable power use; optional DP prolongs; time owner/recipient specific.
eventSemantics.Regimen: One active benefit in 24 hours, failed same-regimen lockout, Wisdom feat entitlement and no long-rest expiration override.

conditions: Form talent known
Power base activation valid with correct activated lightsaber count
testAssertions: Without matching form talent, rider absent even if another form is active.
With matching form talent and legal base use, the specific rider applies regardless of activeLightsaberForm state.
Base Form Power is usable without the rider, subject to wielded activated lightsaber prerequisites.
